title: Test UI red on main: flow-value-envelope.test.ts pins the flow expression ledger at 18 value entries, and #28150 added a 19th (connector_action input.*)
body:
director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXAezMHTRktYF3knEs

Filing gate: ① a named, reproduced defect (main-red). Blocks: merge queue — every PR queued on `main` since 15:18Z 2026-10-30 is ejected on `Test UI`.

## Business reason

**Who:** every lane landing through the merge queue. **What happens:** `Test UI` is a required context, so each queue build on today's `main` fails and ejects its PR (and every PR stacked behind it). **If not done:** nothing lands on `main` until this one line is fixed.

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts`, case "offers the envelope on exactly the six hand-table key/value maps the ledger names", pins the whole `value`-role list of `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` (18 entries, written at 18.0.0-next.0).
- #28150 (`3cc45cc466`, Fixes #27968, spec lane) declared a 19th `value` entry: `connector_action` `connectorConfig.input.*` (`block: 'connectorConfig'`, path `input.*`). It did not touch `ui/`, so the pinned list no longer matches the ledger.
- The six-map assertion above it is still correct: `isValueEnvelopeSlot` answers only for `config`-rooted maps, and the Studio envelope editor for `connectorConfig.input` is a separate, blocked card (#28164).
- Full diagnosis: PR #28116 comment 6526830338.

## Fix (one line plus a comment)

In the expected ledger list, add `'connector_action:input.*'` between `'assignment:assignments.*'` and `'create_record:fields.*'` (sorted order), and extend the comment above it to say the list grew at #27968 / #28150 with the one entry rooted in `connectorConfig`. ⛔ Do not change the six-map assertion.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts` is green on `main` + the fix.
- [ ] The six-map case's `offered` list is unchanged.
- [ ] A queue build of the fix PR passes `Test UI`; #28184 (the queue-flake anchor this red opened) is closed with this card's PR.

## Affected runs

- Queue build [41080050426](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41080050426) (#28116, inherited).
- Queue build [41079610849](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41079610849) (#28131, stack root).

## Reader and dedupe

- **Who acts:** the next `domain:ui` seat when the ui lane restarts, or a one-line fix PR on the maintainer's word.
- **Dedupe:** issue search `flow-value-envelope connector_action input FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` (open + closed): 29 hits. Only #28184 names this test file; it is the merge-queue-triage workflow's name-only anchor, not a diagnosis, so this card carries the cause and the fix. #28164 (Studio envelope editor for `connectorConfig.input`, p2, blocked) is related, not a duplicate.
